description: The listing identifiers the caller has muted on XP -- 'what have I hidden?'. Muting is a per-user view setting and does not change the listing itself. Muted listings are left out of list_open_listings and hidden on xp.tickets; get_market_read counts every fan listing, muted or not. Requires sign-in.
name: list_muted_listings
title: List Muted Listings
